raw_train_cache_note: Reuses the exact same cache directory as outputs/unetr_style_level0_full_width_augmented_decoder's training run -- the raw preprocessed (image, target) pairs cached there depend only on (image_path, mask_path, spacing, tile_size), never on decoder architecture, so this is a legitimate, correct reuse (skips redundant preprocessing), not a shortcut that risks mixing runs.
architecture_change: Combines the two independent wins validated tonight, together for the first time: (1) PaperStyleLevel0OneQueryMaskDecoder / PaperUnetrUpBlock -- the original paper's real upsampling mechanism (free trilinear interpolation + 1x1x1 conv, not a learned transposed convolution), from outputs/paper_style_level0_decoder/; (2) the original paper's richer training augmentation (rotation, zoom, Gaussian blur/noise, brightness/contrast, gamma, simulated low-resolution), from outputs/unetr_style_level0_full_width_augmented_decoder/. Both were validated independently (each alone reached verdict A against the current-best model); this run tests whether they compose additively. Same level0_width=32, same initial checkpoint, same resolution/loss/optimizer/seed as both prior runs.
